status.en: 80 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 22% fewer than the week before, most of them in Tehran, Minab and Sistan.
status.nb: 80 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 22 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Teheran, Minab og Sistan.

summary.en: Iranian IRGC has pledged an offensive invasion while Houthi missiles struck Saudi Arabia's King Fahd airport, killing one person and wounding eight. The US ordered some personnel to leave Saudi Arabia and advised diplomats to depart amid the attacks. US and Israel are reportedly drafting plans for renewed strikes on Iran after the US midterm elections. Lavrov visited Tehran and publicly backed Iran, suggesting possible Russian involvement. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
